title: SAP S/4HANA released CDS views, master data: customer, product, supplier, company code, sales organization (I_Customer, I_Product, ...)
status_note: Proposed, not tested on a customer. Every view, key, association and amount below is taken from public documentation and written in our own words; none of it has been checked against an SAP system by this project, and where a page could not be opened the source says so. validate_plan checks it against your rows. A pack is a sourced suggestion, not proof.

variants.ecc: SAP ERP 6.0 (ECC). Field lengths and tables as documented for ECC; not verified per enhancement package.
variants.s4hana: SAP S/4HANA (on-premise and private cloud). Not verified per release.

sap_release_list.title: SAP Cloudification Repository: the released objects of SAP S/4HANA Cloud (objectReleaseInfoLatest.json, objectReleaseInfo_PCELatest.json): which CDS views are released, deprecated, and their successors
sap_release_list.note: Read 15 November 2026 (repository commit of 12 November 2026). Gives the release state of each view named here (all 'released'; I_Material is not to be released, C_SalesDocumentItemDEX is deprecated for C_SalesDocumentItemDEX_1). It lists no fields, keys or associations.

tables.name: I_CUSTOMER
tables.note: A customer can be a person: the name, address and telephone fields are named as personal data, so sample_rows masks them.

corresponds_to.note: One row per KNVV row: a customer in a sales area.

tables.name: I_PRODUCT

corresponds_to.note: One row per MARA row; Product is the material number (MATNR).

tables.note: Product is 40 characters in S/4HANA; numeric material numbers are stored with leading zeros.

tables.name: I_PRODUCT_TEXT
tables.note: One row per product and language: filter on Language before joining, or every line is repeated once per language.

traps.title: Text views have one row per language
traps.text: I_ProductText has one row per product and language; filter Language before joining.

traps.title: Leading zeros stay in an extraction
traps.text: Customer, Product, SalesDocument and the other number fields are text; an extraction holds the stored value, numeric numbers right-aligned with leading zeros (SalesDocument '0000012345'), while a screen or an OData service may show 12345. A join with a source that stores the short form finds nothing. Pad or strip on one side, the same way everywhere.
